fact: The Ké-Non system, adopted in May 2023, runs a payment module for the conditional cash transfer programme with the Banco Internacional de São Tomé e Príncipe and identifies clients against the national civil registry; the social registry was updated between December 2023 and February 2024.
title: (Em-)powered by openIMIS, the island nation Sao Tomé and Principe is effectively managing its social protection programs
